title: Tiny opening
text: Tiny opening. Awesome quality bags but the opening isn’t the advertised width. It’s a bit smaller, making these very challenging to fit contents inside. They seal very well and work best with loose ingredients, not loaves of bread or cookies.

product_metadata.title: Delove 50pcs Reusable Airtight Food Storage Bags - Great for Dry Food Storage Cookies,Candy,Coffee, Tea, Cereal,Flour & Sugar - Resealable Clear Party Favor Treat Bags Pouches -Standable (Transparent, 4 x 7.9 Inch)
features: Eight-sides design - Compared with ordinary food bags, Eight-sides design can double the storage capacity,and allows them to stand or stack like bricks to save space.

Wide applications - Ideal for party favor treat bags and packing coffee beans, bath salt, candy, pill, sugar, rice, cookie, tea, nuts, dried fruit, snacks, popcorn, beef jerky, or other food you want to store.Particularly suitable for granular, powder or small objects.

Resealable zipper - You can either manual seal zipper part, or you can heat seal the open top section above the zipper, so that achieve storage effect, and these food storage bags can be applied many times.

Convenient to use - Just open and seal, very easy to use for packing and storing, transparent material allowing for a quick glance at contents inside, please make sure to close the zipper seal tight to prevent leakage and ensure freshness.
Food Grade Material - These resealable bags are made of food grade polyethylene material, you can put items in them safely.Also,these high-quality bags make your food look more quality.
Package Includes - You will get 50 pieces resealable food storage bags in one package, large quantity for satisfying your usage and replacement, or you can share with others
